newsitem.title: UK: GOLF-OZAKI KANEKO AND PERRY WITHDRAW FROM BRITISH OPEN.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-OZAKI KANEKO AND PERRY WITHDRAW FROM BRITISH OPEN.

text.p: Naomichi "Joe" Ozaki and Yoshinori Kaneko of Japan along with American Chris Perry withdrew from the British Open at Royal Troon on Friday with injuries.
Ozaki has a wrist injury and Kaneko a back problem, while Perry is suffering from a thigh injury.
They join former champion Ian Baker-Finch of Australia on the sidelines. The field has been reduced to 152.
Baker-Finch, the Australian who won at Royal Birkdale in 1991, pulled out after shooting a 21-over-par 92 in the opening round.
